grid.strand: English & Communication (FS Level 1 to 2; Entry 3 floor)
grid.outcomes: Read and analyse a whole text about identity; infer meaning and support with evidence; compare viewpoints across texts; deliver a formal presentation; write accurate, well-structured prose (L1-2).
grid.activities: Class reader on identity/belonging; inference and analysis work; 'who I am' formal presentation (blends PSHE/Careers); explicit vocabulary and comparison teaching. ICT: research and word-process.
grid.vocab: infer, analyse, viewpoint, compare, evidence, cohesion, register
grid.texts: The Boy at the Back of the Class; Coming to England (BHM); 'Refugees' (Bilston); non-fiction articles
grid.qualification: Pearson Functional Skills English Level 1 to Level 2 (reading, writing, SLC); Entry 3 / Step Up to English floor where needed; AQA UAS 'Reading & analysis', 'Spoken presentation'.
grid.assessment: F: baseline reading age & writing screen (Sep); analysis checks.  S: presentation + descriptive/narrative writing (Oct) + FS L1-2 evidence.
grid.send_smsc: Vocabulary pre-teach, sentence frames, knowledge organisers, extended time; Entry 3 floor tasks for lowest learners. SMSC: Int'l Literacy Day, Black History Month.

grid.strand: English & Communication (FS Level 1 to 2; Entry 3 floor)
grid.outcomes: Distinguish fact, opinion and bias; compare purpose, audience and viewpoint across non-fiction; write a formal text (article/report/persuasive) using paragraphs, discourse markers and accuracy (L1-2).
grid.activities: Comparative non-fiction analysis on community/belonging; formal and persuasive writing (blends Computing); proofreading and redrafting (Anti-Bullying Week). ICT: research and produce a formal digital text.
grid.vocab: fact, opinion, bias, audience, purpose, discourse marker, cohesion
grid.texts: Paired non-fiction articles; model reports; real-world/transactional texts
grid.qualification: Pearson Functional Skills English Level 1 to Level 2 (reading & writing); Entry 3 floor where needed; AQA UAS 'Writing for purpose'.
grid.assessment: F: reading quizzes, writing checklists.  S: formal/persuasive text + reading assessment (Dec) + FS L1-2 evidence.
grid.send_smsc: Writing frames, spell-check protocols, chunked texts; Entry 3 floor tasks. SMSC: Anti-Bullying Week, Human Rights Day.

grid.strand: Maths & Numeracy (White Rose Year 5/6; FS L1-2, Entry 3 floor)
grid.outcomes: Read, write, order, compare and round numbers to 1,000,000 and decimals; use negative numbers; add, subtract, multiply and divide efficiently; find equivalent fractions and calculate with fractions.
grid.activities: WRS Y5/6 place-value, four-operations and fractions small steps; reasoning and real-money problems (blends Careers). ICT: spreadsheets.
grid.vocab: place value, round, negative, factor, equivalent, fraction
grid.texts: WRS Y5/6 units; place-value & fraction resources; real number contexts
grid.qualification: Pearson Functional Skills Maths L1-2 (Y5/6 spine); Entry 3 floor; AQA UAS 'Using number'.
grid.assessment: F: baseline + number/fraction checks. S: number & fractions assessment (Oct) + FS L1-2/UAS.
grid.send_smsc: CPA, worked examples, reduced-density sheets; Entry 3 floor tasks; Yr3/4 gap-fill. PfA: financial capability.

grid.strand: Maths & Numeracy (White Rose Year 5/6; FS L1-2, Entry 3 floor)
grid.outcomes: Add, subtract and multiply fractions and find fractions of amounts; divide up to 4-digit numbers by 1- and 2-digit numbers; solve multi-step multiplication and division problems in context.
grid.activities: WRS Y5/6 fractions and mult/div small steps; long division; multi-step problem-solving (blends Careers). ICT: online tools, data.
grid.vocab: numerator, denominator, remainder, multi-step, written method
grid.texts: WRS Y5/6 units; fraction walls; White Rose materials
grid.qualification: Pearson Functional Skills Maths L1-2; Entry 3 floor; AQA UAS 'Using number', 'Fractions'.
grid.assessment: F: fraction & method checks. S: fractions & mult/div assessment (Dec) + FS L1-2/UAS.
grid.send_smsc: Fraction walls, scaffolded steps; Entry 3 floor tasks; KS3 stretch. PfA: number for life.

grid.activities: Functional digital tasks, email, online forms, job-search and applications (blends with Careers); presentation and document work; digital-footprint and online-safety review. ICT is also embedded across every subject (see 'ICT embedded' notes).
grid.vocab: research, application, email, document, footprint, online safety
grid.texts: Functional apps; online-safety and careers resources
grid.qualification: Functional digital skills (toward FS ICT); AQA UAS, 'Using digital tools for work', 'Staying safe online'.
grid.assessment: F: skills observation.  S: digital task for next steps (e.g. application/presentation) (Jul).
grid.send_smsc: Step-by-step guides, templates, paired support. SMSC: online respect; PfA: digital skills for work.

grid.strand: Creative Arts (Art, Music, Drama) + Arts Award Explore/Bronze
grid.outcomes: Create art inspired by nature and the environment; develop and refine technique; review own and others' work; build Arts Award Bronze evidence.
grid.activities: Environmental art and design (blends with Science/Geography); recycled-materials project; explore an environmental artist; arts log and review.
grid.vocab: natural form, texture, design, refine, review, environment
grid.texts: Trinity Arts Award Bronze resources; recycled materials; artist case studies
grid.qualification: Trinity Arts Award Bronze (develop skills & arts inspiration); AQA UAS, 'Creating artwork'.
grid.assessment: F: arts-log review.  S: environment artwork + Bronze evidence (May).
grid.send_smsc: Choice of media, multisensory resources, visual logs. SMSC: Earth Day, World Environment Day.

grid.strand: Creative Arts (Art, Music, Drama) + Arts Award Explore/Bronze
grid.outcomes: Take part in the school production; develop a role and perform for an audience; review the experience; complete Arts Award sharing evidence.
grid.activities: Rehearsing and performing in the summer production; backstage and design roles; structured review; sharing skills with others (blends with English).
grid.vocab: production, role, perform, audience, review, share
grid.texts: Trinity Arts Award resources; production scripts and stimulus
grid.qualification: Trinity Arts Award Bronze (arts skills & sharing); AQA UAS, 'Taking part in a performance', 'Reviewing the arts'.
grid.assessment: F: rehearsal participation.  S: performance + arts-log review (Jul).
grid.send_smsc: Choice of role, scripted cues, low-pressure options. SMSC: celebration, school community.

grid.strand: Physical Wellbeing (PE Passport)
grid.outcomes: Develop athletics and outdoor/adventurous skills; improve personal fitness and set targets; show teamwork, leadership and resilience; take part in Sports Day.
grid.activities: Athletics and OAA; personal-fitness targets and tracking; team challenges and leadership; Sports Day preparation and participation (blends with PSHE).
grid.vocab: athletics, target, fitness, teamwork, leadership, resilience
grid.texts: PE Passport KS3 units; athletics and OAA equipment; fitness tools
grid.qualification: PE & wellbeing (PE Passport assessment); AQA UAS, 'Athletics', 'Healthy active lifestyle'.
grid.assessment: F: PE Passport assessment.  S: athletics profile + fitness target review (Jul).
grid.send_smsc: Differentiated activities, adapted equipment, choice of role. SMSC: Sports Day, school community; PfA: health.

grid.strand: Personal Effectiveness, Independence & Careers (ASDAN PEQ E3–L1 + Employability)
grid.outcomes: Carry out living-independently and gardening/hospitality tasks; complete a supported work-experience encounter; finish ASDAN units and review my plan for the future.
grid.activities: ASDAN Living Independently, Gardening and Hospitality short-course tasks; supported work experience; PEQ Level 1 completion and review; transition planning (blends with English/PSHE).
grid.vocab: independence, work experience, gardening, hospitality, transition, review
grid.texts: ASDAN Living Independently/Gardening/Hospitality resources; PEQ E3–L1; work-experience resources
grid.qualification: ASDAN PEQ Level 1 Award (completed); ASDAN short courses (Living Independently, Gardening, Hospitality) + Employability; AQA UAS, 'Work experience', 'Living independently'.
grid.assessment: F: challenge and routine tracking.  S: work-experience evidence + PEQ Award completed (Jul).
grid.send_smsc: Visual task sequences, real work contexts, structured templates. SMSC: aspiration; PfA: employment, independent living.

grid.strand: Design & Technology (ASDAN Foodwise / Textiles / Construction)
grid.outcomes: Work safely and hygienically; follow a design-make-evaluate cycle; prepare simple food and make a textile item; evaluate against a brief.
grid.activities: Kitchen hygiene & tool use; prepare a healthy snack; explore fabrics and joining; design & make a simple textile item; photo-record and evaluate. ICT: research designs, cost on a spreadsheet.
grid.vocab: design, make, evaluate, hygiene, fabric, seam, brief, product
grid.texts: Food/DT room; kitchen & textiles equipment; recipe cards; ASDAN Foodwise & Textiles resources; PPE
grid.qualification: ASDAN Foodwise & Textiles short courses (Entry 3 / Level 1); AQA UAS 'Designing a product', 'Making a product', 'Food & nutrition'.
grid.assessment: F: hygiene & process observation.  S: finished food + textile product with evaluation.
grid.send_smsc: Task analysis, visual sequences, adapted tools, modelling. PfA: independent living, employment. Cross-curric: Maths (measuring), ICT (recording).

grid.strand: Design & Technology (ASDAN Foodwise / Textiles / Construction)
grid.outcomes: Identify materials, tools and hazards; mark out, make and test a simple structure; evaluate strength and finish; suggest improvements.
grid.activities: Construction/making: safety and tools; plan and mark out; build and test a structure/model; evaluate and refine. ICT: photograph process, present evaluation.
grid.vocab: material, tool, hazard, structure, join, test, evaluate, improve
grid.texts: Construction/making area; wood/junk-modelling & simple tools; ASDAN Construction resources; PPE
grid.qualification: ASDAN Construction/Making short course (Entry 3 / Level 1); AQA UAS 'Making a product', 'Using tools safely'.
grid.assessment: F: safe-working observation.  S: constructed product + evaluation (data drop).
grid.send_smsc: Supervised practice, adapted tools, visual H&S prompts. PfA: employment. Cross-curric: Enterprise, Community Project.

grid.strand: Community Project & Vocational (flexible – adapt to your local area)
grid.outcomes: Explore the local community and identify a need or opportunity; agree a goal and roles; plan steps and make first contact with a partner.
grid.activities: ADAPT to your school's local area, partners and facilities (allotment, café, charity, recycling, employer, care home, etc.). Team planning; identify a local project; assign roles; contact a partner/visitor; begin an early task. ICT: research and plan digitally.
grid.vocab: community, project, goal, role, plan, partner, contribution
grid.texts: Local community links & partners (school to source); enterprise/allotment/café resources; visitors & venues; PPE
grid.qualification: ASDAN Careers & Experiencing Work / Employability; AQA UAS 'Working as a team', 'Contributing to the community'.
grid.assessment: F: project-planning log.  S: agreed project plan + first contribution evidence.
grid.send_smsc: Outcomes are deliberately generic – map onto YOUR local project. Structured roles, visual planners. PfA: employment, community, self-determination.

grid.strand: Community Project & Vocational (flexible – adapt to your local area)
grid.outcomes: Carry out a vocational/community task safely; record evidence; link the work to careers; reflect on teamwork and impact.
grid.activities: ADAPT to your school's local area, partners and facilities (allotment, café, charity, recycling, employer, care home, etc.). Deliver a task/service; use correct equipment & PPE; gather evidence; link to a job role; present impact. ICT: record and present the project.
grid.vocab: vocational, service, feedback, evidence, career, impact, reflect
grid.texts: Local partners & venues; enterprise resources; PPE; camera/device for evidence
grid.qualification: ASDAN Employability / short courses; AQA UAS 'Experiencing work', 'Community contribution'.
grid.assessment: F: project log.  S: project outcome + reflection evidence (data drop).
grid.send_smsc: Adapt task complexity to learners; scaffolded reflection. PfA: employment, community. Cross-curric: D&T, Enterprise, Careers.

Build → Grow → Launch is a laddered curriculum: every learner has an accessible, accredited next step, and can move up or down a pathway as an individual. Entry Level → Functional Skills → GCSE is the core English/maths/science spine. Each cell shows the pathway's TARGET and, where relevant, the FLOOR for the lowest learners so no one is stranded.
